description: Re-index the repo after batch edits so subsequent gp_* calls see your changes. Call after any non-trivial edit session. Do NOT call before every query — indexing is slow; only needed when source files changed.

path.description: Repo root with a GraphPilot index. Optional: when omitted, resolves via GRAPHPILOT_ROOT, MCP workspace roots, parent walk, or a single ~/.graphpilot index.

name: gp_index
